'''Trinn berries''' were [[Berry/Legends|berries]] [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that could be found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> while staying at Poln Major's [[Hewntree Hotel]], the Human [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] ate several trinn berries that she took from the [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] bowl in her [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] room.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trinn berries appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
